LIMIT_OF_THIS_INSTRUMENT.what_it_cannot_see: any change that adds no parameter. A signature, a convention, a dtype rule and an autocast boundary are all invisible to named_parameters(), so `modules_identical` is a true statement about names and NOT a statement that the boundary leaves those modules alone.
LIMIT_OF_THIS_INSTRUMENT.what_survives: the diffusion-scope claim this row acts on. 0.4.3 exposes 24 per-block attention_pair_bias.layer_norm_z tensors that 0.5.0 does not, which is a parameter-set difference and therefore exactly what this instrument CAN see, and it is the difference the repaired capture turns on. The 7.55x between the two captures is measured arm-to-arm (r043_ours vs r050_ours), not inferred from this diff.
LIMIT_OF_THIS_INSTRUMENT.what_this_file_measures: the set of parameter NAMES the model exposes under each tree, diffed by top-level module

what: the FULL model parameter set built under each tree and diffed by name. The repaired denominator is a diffusion-scope repair only if diffusion_module is the only module whose parameter NAMES move, which is the claim D58 rests on.
